claims.text: The candidate improves specific helper reliability behaviors; this is not a measured model quality gain.

intentional_changes: Default verifier limits:50 checkers,50 refs/result,1024 metadata characters,2000 summary characters and8000 total summary characters. Configurable; checker over-capacity rejected before callbacks. Not blanket backward compatibility.
Inconsistent present correction relationships rejected. Missing deleted-history references remain accepted.
limitations: No promises or guarantees; best effort only.
Synthetic helper checks do not establish general model accuracy, intent prediction or native host discovery.
Callbacks remain trusted code; retained-output bounds do not sandbox execution, allocations or runtime, redact all PII or prove injection resistance.
HTTP transport tests use mocks. Upgrade inventories observe persistent effects, not every transient write or syscall.
Remote GitHub CI executes after publication; this snapshot cannot claim its future result.
